disputes.a: PowerPyx places the final mission in Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero).
disputes.b: ofzenandcomputing, Insider Gaming, Beebom and CULTR word it as Chapter 5. Push Square and KeenGamer say only 'the final mission'.
disputes.call: The trophy is for the final mission either way — finish the story and it pops; do not plan around the chapter number.
disputes.topic: Which chapter holds the final mission?
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase say roughly 200 hours.
disputes.b: Push Square's intro says 'up to 300 hours or more'.
disputes.call: Plan 200 hours for the checklist route; budget 200–300 if you play at a relaxed pace.
Plan 60–80 hours for the story; the difference is pacing, not content.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase flag Positive Mental Attitude as the one possibly missable trophy.
disputes.b: ofzenandcomputing notes community discussion suggesting no trophy is missable, but calls that unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation; it costs a minute and removes the risk either way.

disputes.a: Push Square lists it as Bronze.
disputes.b: The official list, KeenGamer and ofzenandcomputing all say Silver.
disputes.call: We follow the official list — Silver.

disputes.a: PowerPyx says all five character questlines stay available after the story.
disputes.b: TechWiser (reported by eGamers) says the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows linked to story progress. Only one source gives that warning.
disputes.call: Start each chain the moment it unlocks and keep a chapter-end save; do not leave them to post-story cleanup.
disputes.topic: Do the stranger chains have story-progress windows?

disputes.a: PowerPyx describes Bret's chain (hunt the animals he requests; 15 Target Decks) and says it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks the trophy.
disputes.b: KeenGamer and eGamers list the trophy as unconfirmed, and eGamers adds that it is unknown which animal Fair Game asks for.
disputes.call: Work Bret's whole chain — the 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a specific method: after Chapter 3's Credit Check, return to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba as Lucia alone, rob the 3 cash drawers and escape on foot.
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and eGamers lists it as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method, but treat it as unconfirmed until a second source confirms it.
disputes.topic: Bad Luck, I Guess — what is the method?

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a specific method: a UFO easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo, with a random spawn.
disputes.b: KeenGamer lists it as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, and eGamers lists it as unconfirmed — though eGamers notes GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method, but treat it as unconfirmed until a second source confirms it.
disputes.topic: The Truth Is Out There — what is the method?

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a specific method: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the exact trigger is still being confirmed, and eGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method, but treat it as unconfirmed until a second source confirms it.
disputes.topic: In The Beginning… — what exactly triggers it?

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a specific method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City (needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3) and drive it through the window.
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed, and eGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed — though eGamers notes GTABase agrees it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method; the showroom-window part has a second source behind it.
disputes.topic: Capital Offense — which car, and does it work?

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives a specific method: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed, and eGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's method, but treat it as unconfirmed until a second source confirms it.
disputes.topic: Ten Pin — what is the method?

disputes.a: PowerPyx's sub-guide title says 12 shooting range locations.
disputes.b: Push Square names 2 ranges in Leonida — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero) — with 42 challenges across three difficulty tiers.
disputes.call: The trophy tracks the 42 gold medals either way; the ranges are the two Push Square names.
disputes.topic: How many shooting ranges are there?
